profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Software Engineer skilled in Embedded Software, VxWorks, C#, Electrical Engineering, and Programming. Strong engineering professional with a MS focused in Electrical Engineering from Binghamton University.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mission Systems and Training (MST) Orlando FL
positions.description:
•	Embedded application development (C/C++, embedded Linux)
•	Simulation technology and testing
•	Extensive Bash scripting
•	Build scripting (Make, Rake, Bash)
•	C++/C# Windows application Development and integration
•	Experience with Video card operations (switching, overlay)
•	Serial interface applications RS232/RS422
•	TCPIP/UDP Communications/QoS (Windows)
•	Procedural and scripted Software Verification
•	Testing Application Software for Display products
•	Diagnostic Software for Embedded devices
•	Extensive test procedure development
•	Authoring requirements for software programs
•	VB programming and extensive Excel Macro Experience

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Embedded application development (C/C++, VxWorks 5.5, Tornado 2.2.1, Integrity, MULTI/AdaMULTI)
•	Project Lead responsibilities (including resource management and cost analysis)
•	C++/C# Windows application Development
•	Embedded device drivers
•	OpenGl modeling tools (Idata,GLStudio)
•	Graphics development for aircraft displays
•	Experience with Video card operations (switching, overlay)
•	MIL-STD 1553 applications
•	Serial interface applications RS232/RS422
•	TCPIP/UDP Communications/QoS (Windows)
•	Procedural and scripted Software Verification
•	Testing Application Software for Display products
•	Diagnostic Software for Embedded devices
•	Extensive test procedure development
•	Authoring requirements for software programs
•	DO-178B level A development
•	VB programming and extensive Excel Macro Experience
•	MFC, ATL, STL Programming

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
(Contractor)
Design test circuits for green laser controller

Program design in Verilog using Quartus II and NIOS II IDE
Testing high speed and multi-channel ADC/DAC on FPGA Expansion boards

Implement Designs on StratixII FPGA

C++, C# PC application to convert images to green-scale and use a Serial Port interface with the FPGA to green laser control command functions and transmit test data

positions.title: Seargant (E-5)19K20 M1A1 Tank Gunner
positions.description:
• Honorable discharge in September 1998
• Achieved Rank of Sergeant (E-5)
• Awarded: two Army Commendation Medals, two Army Achievement Medals, Good Conduct Medal

• Awarded two Certificates of Achievement 
• Attended Non Commissioned Officers Academy (PLDC)
• Managed up to eight subordinates in daily work and training
• Responsible for training of subordinates
• Responsible for maintenance and repairs of M1A1 tank
• Includes mechanical, electrical and computer troubleshooting and repair

• Responsible for ballistic computer
• Heavy work with hand tools
